title: The WP Photo Album Plus WordPress plugin before 9.3.04.004 does not verify the origin or a security token for one of…
description: The WP Photo Album Plus WordPress plugin versions before 9.3.04.004 contain a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify the origin or a security token for a comment-management request. This flaw allows attackers to delete photo comments by tricking a logged-in user with comment-moderation rights into loading a crafted page.
